name: Default SDLC Workflow
description:
Baseline graph-based SDLC workflow, from initial intake through maintenance. Each node is a stage that produces an artifact; nextNodes defines allowed forward/rework transitions. This is data, not code — the workflow engine (LangGraph, later) will interpret it.

SCOPE NOTE (v0.3.0): Low-Level Design, Implementation Planning, Implementation, PR Review, and Testing are deliberately NOT project-level stages here anymore — once Story Crafting is approved, each story runs its own LLD/Implementation Plan/Implementation/PR Review/Testing individually, in parallel, via its own StoryDeliveryLane (see app/services/story_delivery.py and the Stories tab). Keeping a second, project-level copy of the same five stages was confusing and redundant now that the real per-story lane is where that work actually happens. Infrastructure Planning/Provisioning stay project-level — infra decisions span every story, not just one.

nodes.name: Requirement Intake
nodes.description: Capture the initial stakeholder request, desired outcome, and any known constraints before analysis begins.

nodes.name: Problem Discovery
nodes.description: Investigate the underlying problem, its impact, and constraints, and state it clearly enough to design against.

nodes.name: Solution Discovery
nodes.description: Explore candidate solution approaches, weigh trade-offs, and recommend one to move forward with.

nodes.name: High-Level Design
nodes.description: Define the system-level architecture and major components for the chosen solution.

nodes.name: Story Crafting
nodes.description: Break the approved high-level design into implementable stories/tasks with acceptance criteria. Once approved, each story runs its own LLD/Implementation Plan/Implementation/PR Review/Testing individually via the Stories tab — see this template's own top-level description.

nodes.name: Infrastructure Planning
nodes.description: Plan the environments, CI/CD pipeline, secrets, monitoring, security, rollback, and cost approach needed to release this change, based on the approved HLD and the approved story backlog (per-story LLDs/Implementation Plans are drafted individually, per story, in each story's own lane — not project-level inputs here).

nodes.name: Infrastructure Provisioning
nodes.description: Provision and configure the infrastructure and environments required to release the change, per the approved Infrastructure Plan.

nodes.name: Release
nodes.description: Deploy the change to production and record the deployment outcome.

nodes.name: Maintenance
nodes.description: Monitor the released change, capture incidents and feedback, and feed learnings back into future intake.
